disputes.created: Dispute {{code}} raised. A coordinator will review it.
disputes.description: Issues raised on your lots and how each one was resolved.
disputes.descriptionHint: Include weights, dates and who you spoke to. Facts help us resolve it faster.
disputes.emptyBody: If a weight, grade, payment or pickup does not match what was agreed, raise it here. A coordinator reviews every case.
disputes.noLots: You are not part of any lot yet.
disputes.pendingResolution: A coordinator will review the delivery record, weights and quality report, then write the outcome here. Settlement for this lot is held until then.
disputes.raiseBody: Tell us what did not match the agreement. Settlement for the lot is paused while a coordinator reviews it.
disputes.title: Disputes

notifications.description: Offers, consents, pickups and payments that need your attention, newest first.
notifications.emptyBody: When an offer arrives, a lot needs your consent or a payment lands, you will hear about it here.
notifications.title: Notifications

settings.aiLiveBody: Voice listings, deal advice and counter-offer suggestions are drafted by a language model. Every number it shows is computed by MandiMate, not guessed — and nothing is sent or accepted without you.
settings.aiMockBody: No AI model is connected, so suggestions come from transparent, deterministic rules. The net-earnings maths is identical either way.
settings.description: Your profile, preferred language, location and password.
settings.languageBody: Screens, SMS and voice prompts use this language.
settings.locationBody: Your location sets transport distances, so the net you see after freight stays honest.
settings.passwordBody: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
settings.profileBody: Coordinators and buyers see your name; we use your phone or email for offers and payments.
settings.title: Settings

verification.description: Share your business documents so farmers can trade with you as a verified partner.
verification.hintBuyer: e.g. GSTIN 29ABCDE1234F1Z5, FSSAI licence, APMC trader licence.
verification.hintTransporter: e.g. RC book KA-01-AB-1234, goods-carriage permit, valid insurance until March.
verification.noNote: Your documents note is with the reviewer.
verification.notNeededBody: Verification applies to buyers and transporters. Your account is ready to use.
verification.pendingBody: An administrator usually reviews requests within one working day. You can keep trading meanwhile; farmers will see you as pending.
verification.privacy: Only MandiMate administrators see this note.
verification.rejectNote: If a request is rejected, the reviewer explains why and you can apply again.
verification.rejectedTitle: Your last request was not approved
verification.requestBody: List the documents you can share — GSTIN, FSSAI or APMC licence for buyers; RC book, permit and insurance for transporters. An administrator may call to confirm.
verification.requestTitle: Tell us about your business documents
verification.sent: Request sent. We will let you know once it is reviewed.
verification.title: Verification
verification.verifiedBody: Farmers and coordinators see the verified mark beside your name on every offer and trip. Keep your details current in Settings.
verification.why1Buyer: Farmers weigh offers by who is buying. A verified mark raises your acceptance rate.
verification.why1Transporter: Coordinators assign pooled pickups to verified transporters before anyone else.
verification.why2Body: Verified partners carry a lower payment-delay risk in every farmer’s net earnings comparison.
verification.why3Body: If a dispute arises, verified records make it faster to resolve for everyone.
